'''Admiral Thrawn Flagship Operations''' is a strategy article published on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]] under the handle Admiral Thrawn, titled ''Flagship Operations...Is It Powerful...Or Not????''.<ref name="or">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Flagship.htm Flagship Operations...Is It Powerful...Or Not????], The Outer Rim (Admiral Thrawn). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261030142346/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Flagship.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Article ==

<blockquote>
<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:inherit"><nowiki>
Title: Flagship
Operations...Is It Powerful...Or Not????


So I said to myself, "How is Flagship Operations going to give me tremendous
power at a fast output; then it hit me, this card was not meant to be spread
across the galaxy, just setralized in a couple of systems." With this card,
it is the combination of Star Destroyers and TIEs into a 60 card deck. The strategy
is to get Executor sites out as quickly as possible, and to get this card into
play as fast as possible. Once it's out, sliding TIEs and Star Destroyers can
literally hyperdrive out onto the table. The Tie's from the Official Tournament
Sealed Deck become cheap, but for destiny sake go with the Tie Scouts, add a
few more cards such as this one I like: Flagship Operations & death Squadron
at Kiffex with Presence of the Force. I hope you have enjoyed the short Articles,
and that they may help you out!


Admiral
Thrawn
</nowiki></div>
</blockquote>
